THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My Reference No.: 4/1/1/32-L. Land Ministry Ref. No.: 4-3/7/2019/HW/426. I do hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following lands which are required for a public purpose: Description of the land to be acquired: Ten (10) allotments of land from Lot 01 to 10 in Extent of 0.1557 Hectare of land, depicted in Cadastral Map No. 420397 Block No. 01 Sheet No. 01, Dated 22nd May, 2023, prepared by the senior Superintendent of Surveys, Kurunegala District on behalf of the Surveyor General, situated in the Village of Nailiya in the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 823, Nailiya of the Divisional Secretary's Division of Nailiya in the District of Kurunegala, in North Western Province.
